Gets the Cloud Connector Group details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/cloudConnectorGroup/:id

Gets the Cloud Connector Group details for the specified ID.

Request
​

int64

REQUIRED
